verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. In both, the photo is cropped so tightly that only the man's mouth and chin show: his face, glasses and upward gaze are gone, and so is the image's meaning. The 'HOW IT WORKS?' headline is small and sits on the doodles (the question mark and molecule scribbles run through it). The subtitle wraps raggedly into four lines ('HARRY LEE / HOFFMAN') and is pushed against the right edge. The middle of the banner is a dead grey gap, so it reads as a squashed crop rather than a designed banner.
